entries.title: A swipe down right after a double-tap closes the picture viewer on your iPhone
entries.body: On your iPhone or iPad, a swipe down that started while the full-screen viewer for a picture or a diagram was still zooming from a double-tap did nothing, and the viewer stayed open. The viewer now reads that swipe and closes.
entries.noPicture: The viewer looks the same; only a swipe down that came right after a double-tap, and did nothing before, now closes it.
